messages:
nora: quick sync on model catalog UI tweaks i pushed in figma. focus areas: filter chips with in-line comments, compare table header behavior, perf "sash" visuals, and pin wording. link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/model-catalog

kevin: skimmed. main concern: chips with avatars could overflow in narrow layouts. can we collapse to a compact indicator?

anya: agreed. propose compact state where we show a single tiny avatar + "+N" badge when space is tight. hover expands preview. keeps density for power users.

nora: exactly. idea: small 14px avatar, -4px overlap, with aria-label="comment by <name>" and a role="button" on the chip so keyboard users can open the comment preview.

ben: quick microcopy issue: team members read "Pin" as bookmark. maybe use "Lock" or "Force"? testers reacted to stronger verbs.

kevin: hmm i worry "Force" is too aggressive. what about verbs that indicate routing semantics: "Lock version for this route" or "Fix version (overrides routing)".

tom: prefer explicit: "Lock version for this route 12 (overrides rollout)". but the parenthetical might be noisy in small tooltips.

anya: suggestion: tooltip line 1: "Lock version for this route" line 2: "Overrides rollout rules". two-line tooltip with subtle divider.

nora: i like that. we'll A/B test with a variant that uses "Fix version" to see which reduces support tickets.

kevin: perf sash note: current flame icon draws attention but not contextual. i mocked a tiny radial sparkline + percentile number. visual should maintain 3:1 contrast on text.

ben: also prefer a subtle border for dark-mode to avoid color-only meaning. and add aria-label="performance: 95th percentile latency 120ms".

anya: accessibility checklist I want included: 1) chips keyboard focus (tab + enter opens preview) 2) aria-pressed on toggle filters 3) aria-live polite region for compare table row updates 4) focus trap when comment popover open 5) visible focus ring (not just outline)

kevin: implementation note for sticky header: using position: sticky works horizontally if header is inside the scroll container. i prototyped but ran into shadow clipping; need z-index shim when the compare grid overflows.

nora: good call. can we add a small shadow on sticky state and an aria-hidden attribute for the shadow element? keeps screen readers clean.

ben: microcopy for empty compare state: current: "No models selected". propose: "No models selected 12 Pick models or lock a version to begin comparison." shorter alt: "No models 12 choose or lock a version."

anya: testers preferred short active phrasing. go with: "No models 12 choose or lock a version."

kevin: small CSS idea for chip avatars:

```
.chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.chip .overlap { margin-left:-6px; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg); }
```

kevin: when space < 320px collapse to single indicator element with aria-expanded toggle.

nora: test plan: 1) A/B microcopy for pin/lock (5% each) 2) keyboard nav test cases for compare table 3) contrast checks on sash tokens 4) compact chip behavior on <360px viewport

deploy-bot: Build started for branch feature/catalog-compact-comments (id=1187) 12 running unit + a11y checks. :gear:

ben: FYI unit/a11y flagged missing aria-live on compare-row update; i'll add it.

anya: also add role="dialog" and aria-modal="false" for the comment popover so NVDA won't assume modal behavior.

kevin: timeline: can we aim for design sign-off by mono, dev prototype by wed, behind feature-flag rollout next tuesday?

nora: yes. i'll update the figma frames and export assets. posting final link when ready. thanks all :raised_hands:
